production_kernel_base_revision.boundary: the committed revision containing the bound kernel and parameter module; the runner and this prospective contract are additionally bound by exact file SHA-256

numeric_contract.command_transition_sample_semantics: first sample is one clamp_sample_interval after the voltage transition
numeric_contract.fixed_voltage_update: one vectorized Rush-Larsen production-kernel launch may evaluate all filed sample times because voltage and kinetic parameters are constant within each command segment
numeric_contract.junction_potential_policy: use source command voltages as reported; the papers calculated but did not correct junction potential
numeric_contract.instrument_boundary: source fast-Na signals were sampled at 50 kHz and filtered at 10 kHz; no exact recording-filter transfer function is available, so simulated ideal-current timing is an operational transfer test rather than source equivalence

analysis_contract.steady_state: least-squares normalized-conductance Boltzmann fit over every filed command voltage; activation is computed from current divided by driving force and the powered gate, never from the unpowered gate
analysis_contract.rise_decay: linear interpolation between adjacent samples at 10 and 90 percent of fast-Na peak or 20 and 80 percent of Kv3 asymptote/peak as declared by the source endpoint
analysis_contract.recovery: bounded least-squares biexponential with nonnegative component fractions summing to one
analysis_contract.deactivation: bounded single-exponential current-tail fit with an asymptote, beginning one sample after the command transition
analysis_contract.uncertainty_gate: each promoting scalar must lie within source mean plus or minus two SEM; no aggregate score may compensate for a failed scalar
analysis_contract.authority: only the separate analyzer may assign a Stage 1 verdict; runner outputs are verdict-free observations

stop_rules: stop Stage 1 and revise the state family if any source-transfer hard gate fails; conductance fitting is forbidden
stop as inconclusive if implementation digests, backend identity, complete command ladders, or provenance cannot be authenticated
do not begin compartment integration until the NumPy reference is Stage 1 GO and CuPy parity is established
do not reinterpret a project-operational duration ladder, interpolation, gate root, or instrument-limited target as a source measurement
provenance_exempt: non-executed prospective clamp execution contract; contains no simulation result
